title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 0.44 mm.

title: Lifetime Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the time dilation using tau and gamma.

title: Distance Traveled
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the distance traveled by the mesons using the time and speed of light.

title: Exponential Decay Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the exponential decay equation correctly to find the time limit.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating gamma or tau.

title: Resolution Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should interpret the resolution requirement correctly in the context of the problem.
